title: Datasets and Models for Authorship Attribution on Italian Personal Writings

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing authorship verification performance across single-gender (female-only, male-only) and mixed-gender dataset configurations to measure whether the classifier exploits implicit gender-specific linguistic characteristics as a shortcut instead of recognizing individual writing style.

Conducting intra-topic and cross-topic authorship verification experiments to evaluate if models inappropriately rely on topic-specific vocabulary as a confounding variable rather than true authorship traits.
